title: Zoning text change for 50-20 108th Street, Corona
summary: This application would amend the zoning text to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 50-20 108th Street in Corona, Queens, alongside a related zoning map change. Together the actions would allow two new mixed-use buildings totaling about 216,400 square feet with 196 apartments, including 51 income-restricted units. The Council held a public hearing on June 17, 2026 and the Land Use Committee recommended approval on July 14, 2026.
